provenance: Generated engineering controls only; no acquired patient data, qualification or clinical task success.
randomness: No random calls; source geometry and sequences below are literal.
isolation: One fresh process per warmup/sample; original pre-port source may be captured with git archive. No concurrent heavyweight work.
timing: Complete fresh fixture creation + complete public Generate/search/export; explicit setup and computation also reported. Imports/process startup, output serialization, equality hashes and profiling are separate. Geometry stress includes geometry construction, continuum fixture construction and continuum ticks.

correctness.comparison: Exact canonical JSON digest for every returned field unless explicitly listed below; complete snapshots, ordered history/action/physical-call traces, receipts, decisions, refusal reasons, source/geometry/target memberships, rewards and termination interfaces retain their established exact contracts.
correctness.derivedSealRequirement: Before projection validate semantic_digest over the complete report excluding only comparisonSeal itself. No other seal, proof identity, state identity, backend metadata or numeric field is omitted.
expectedImplementationDifferences: Separately reported backend identity mode, compiler/build/source/binary hashes, module paths, backend execution counters and documented fallback reasons.

Proof/cache identities explicitly bound to implementation must change and be validated by runtime-specific qualification tests; same-build cold load preserves recorded identities. Physical result projection has no generic metadata exclusion.
correctness.processBoundProofReason: Existing JointCranialLimits.declaration hashes frozen_at=time.monotonic() and meter_identity=id(meter); JointResectionGoal.declaration hashes that limitsHash. Thus goalHash differs across fresh processes even on unchanged reference. Each run retains the actual registered goal and verifies _require_goal, goal.content_hash==semantic_digest(goal.declaration()), limits.content_hash==semantic_digest(limits.declaration()), and report goalHash membership. Raw contracts/identities stay in diagnostics. The exact result includes deterministic goal+limits declarations after removing only limits.frozen_at and limits.meter_identity and recomputing normalized limitsHash; all safety/source fields remain exact.
correctness.registeredGoalObservation: The already-supported progress callback reads the existing weak _GOALS registry after forest preparation, filters each fixed source root state, and retains read-only goal refs. It replaces no production function. All seal/registration validation happens after elapsed stops; both backends use this same callback.

performanceGates.report: All paired samples, medians, sample count, min/max/stdev, actual work/call traces and backend counters; no tail-latency claim from five samples.
performanceGates.preportReferenceGuard: Revised reference must reproduce pre-port outcomes and be compared against captured original timing. A slower refactor is not an acceleration baseline.
